zh: ！搞定
en: done!

zh: 刚刚在墙角拿了块扁石头，正好能卡在铁门的门轴下面
en: I just picked up a flat stone in the corner; it fits perfectly under the hinge of the iron door.

zh: 真不敢想象要是一阵风刮过来，把这铁门给合上了，后果得多麻烦
en: I can’t even imagine if a gust of wind came and slammed this iron door shut—what a mess that would be.

zh: 这种老式的门锁要是出个意外，从天台内侧是绝对打不开的
en: If something goes wrong with this old-style lock, there’s absolutely no way to open it from the rooftop side.

zh: 要是真被困在上面……总不能指望有人恰好上来救我吧
en: If I really got trapped up here... I can’t count on someone happening to come up and rescue me.

zh: 这地方，除了保洁阿姨固定来打扫，或者外校人来参观的时候，平时根本没人
en: Aside from the cleaning lady coming on a fixed schedule, or when people from other schools come to visit, there’s basically no one here.

zh: ……总算到六楼了，教学楼的顶层
en: ...Finally made it to the sixth floor—the top of the academic building.

zh: 从教室一路逃过来，腿都软了……早知道平时应该多锻炼的
en: I ran all the way from the classroom; my legs are jelly... I really should work out more.

zh: 楼层的布局倒是很简单，一到四楼是上课的教室，五楼是老师们的办公室，行政主任室也在那一层……
en: The layout is pretty simple: floors one through four are classrooms; the fifth floor is the teachers’ offices, and the Administrative Director’s office is there too...

zh: 刚才在五楼差点撞上教务主任，真够倒霉的
en: I almost ran into the Academic Affairs Director on the fifth floor just now—just my luck.

zh: 说起来，这地方我好像也不是第一次来了……
en: Come to think of it, this doesn’t seem like my first time here...

zh: 上次来……是上周？还是上上周？具体时间完全想不起来了
en: Last time... was it last week? Or the week before? I can’t remember the exact time at all.

zh: 费了这么大劲才上来，要是什么都不干就下去,也不知道能去哪里
en: After all that effort to get up here, if I go back down without doing anything, I don’t even know where I could go.

zh: ……教室是肯定回不去了，我可不想在众目睽睽之下被老师堵在门口训话
en: ...Going back to the classroom is definitely not happening; I don’t want to get stopped at the door and lectured in front of everyone.

zh: 既然来都来了，先四处逛逛吧
en: Since I’m already here, I might as well take a look around first.

zh: 现在你可以按下WASD和方向键来移动人物
en: You can now move the character with WASD and the arrow keys.

zh: 在移动的过程中按下右Shift键可以快速移动
en: While moving, press Right Shift to move faster.

zh: 顺着地上的脚印移动到身后的告示牌上吧
en: Follow the footprints on the ground to the notice board behind you.

zh: 靠近可交互的物体时，人物上方将显示交互图标
en: When you approach an interactive object, an interaction icon will appear above the character.

zh: 同时系统会高亮该物体，使其呈现黄色外发光
en: At the same time, the system will highlight that object with a yellow outer glow.

zh: [!] 表示重要物品，请务必探索，它影响着剧情的推动
en: [!] indicates an important item—be sure to investigate it, as it affects story progression.

zh: [眼睛] 表示普通物体，是否探索并不影响关键剧情
en: [Eye] indicates a regular object; investigating it does not affect the main story.

zh: [√] 表示已完成探索
en: [√] indicates that exploration is complete.

zh: 每当交互图标出现，你可以<color=#FFC600>按下对话键</color>或<color=#FFC600>点击鼠标</color>执行交互操作
en: Whenever the interaction icon appears, you can <color=#FFC600>press the Talk key</color> or <color=#FFC600>click the mouse</color> to interact.

zh: <color=#FFC600>面前的告示牌</color>似乎写着什么，请试着与其交互看看
en: The <color=#FFC600>notice board in front of you</color> seems to have something written on it—try interacting with it.

zh: 一个不起眼的下水道口，周围湿漉漉的
en: A nondescript storm drain; the area around it is slick with moisture.

zh: 你瞥见下水道缝隙中隐隐透着银色的微光
en: You catch a faint silver gleam seeping through the drain’s gaps.

zh: 但扑鼻的异味和黏腻的污垢让你立刻后退半步
en: But the stench and the clammy grime make you instinctively step back.

zh: 这味道……可真够提神醒脑的
en: This smell… sure is eye-opening.

zh: 我可不想为这么点钱弄脏手
en: I’m not getting my hands dirty for that little money.

zh: 我的尊严，可比一枚硬币值钱多了
en: My dignity is worth far more than a single coin.

zh: （你努力不让自己的目光停留在那里，快步离开）
en: (You force your eyes away and hurry off.)

zh: 让硬币留在这里污染环境，也是一种罪过吧？
en: Leaving a coin here to pollute the environment is a sin too, isn’t it?

zh: 对，我这是在……清理环境！
en: Right—this is… environmental cleanup!

zh: （你迅速蹲下了身，小心翼翼地用指甲抠出了硬币）
en: (You crouch quickly and carefully pry the coin out with a fingernail.)

zh: <任务开启>
en: <MISSION START>

zh: 一堆随处可见的碎石头
en: A scatter of loose stones lies everywhere.

zh: 石块的缝隙间生长着一些鲜黄色的花朵，与右侧花圃中种植的品种相同
en: Bright yellow flowers grow in the gaps between the stones, the same variety as those planted in the flowerbed to the right.

zh: 看来是风把花圃的种子带到了这里
en: It seems the wind carried seeds from the flowerbed over here.

zh: 这些花开得倒是挺倔强
en: These flowers are blooming with stubborn tenacity.

zh: （你注意到一抹银光在花影间闪烁）
en: (You notice a flash of silver glint among the flowers’ shadows.)

zh: 连石头缝里都藏着惊喜呢……
en: Even the cracks between the stones hide surprises...

zh: 你将<color=#FFC600> [一枚硬币] </color>放入了背包
en: You put <color=#FFC600>[a coin]</color> into your bag.

zh: 一台指示灯亮起的自助售货机
en: A vending machine with its indicator light on.

zh: 机内饮品陈列整齐，价格标签清晰
en: Inside, the drinks are neatly arranged and the price tags are clear.

zh: 有意思，这种地方居然有台正常供电的售货机
en: Huh, interesting—there’s actually a vending machine here that still has power.

zh: 正好我有点口渴了
en: Perfect, I’m a little thirsty.

zh: （你饶有兴致地浏览着商品，直到看见价格）
en: (You browse the items with interest—until you see the prices.)

zh: 哇，最便宜的矿泉水都要三枚硬币啊……
en: Wow, even the cheapest bottled water costs three coins...

zh: （你不甘心地翻遍所有口袋，最终无力地垂下头）
en: (You rummage through every pocket in frustration, then let your head drop.)

zh: 看来只能去<color=#FFC600>天台边缘</color>和<color=#FFC600>角落</color>仔细找找了，说不定那里能发现什么
en: Looks like I’ll have to search the <color=#FFC600>rooftop edge</color> and the <color=#FFC600>corners</color> carefully—maybe there’s something there.

zh: （你正准备离开，手无意间伸进口袋，指尖触到那几枚刚从天台角落捡来的硬币）
en: (Just as you’re about to leave, your hand slips into your pocket; your fingertips touch the coins you picked up from the rooftop corner.)

zh: 太好了！刚才捡的硬币刚好派上用场！
en: Perfect! The coins I found earlier are just what I need!

zh: （暂时还不太想喝）
en: (I don’t really feel like drinking right now.)

zh: ……主要是这价格，还是再考虑考虑吧
en: …Mostly because of the price—maybe I should think twice.

zh: （你迫不及待地将三枚硬币塞入投币口，按下按钮）
en: (Impatiently, you feed three coins into the slot and press the button.)

zh: 冰凉的液体滑过喉咙，那股灼热的焦躁感终于被镇压了下去
en: The chilled liquid slides down my throat, and that burning restlessness is finally subdued.

zh: 我靠着售货机，长长地舒了一口气
en: I lean against the vending machine and let out a long breath.

zh: 世界仿佛在这一刻被按下了静音键，只剩下心跳逐渐平复的节奏
en: For a moment, the world seems to hit mute; only the slowing rhythm of my heartbeat remains.

zh: 真是不可思议……就是这么普通的东西
en: Incredible… something so ordinary,

zh: 却让我感受到一种被世界宽恕的安宁
en: yet it fills me with a calm, as if the world has forgiven me.

zh: 像有人把体内那根紧绷的弦轻轻松开
en: Like someone gently loosening a taut string inside me.

zh: 我把空瓶在掌心转了半圈，指尖还残着冰意
en: I twirl the empty bottle half a turn in my palm; a trace of cold still lingers on my fingertips.

zh: 售货机的嗡鸣退到远处，光线落在地面，慢慢把影子抚平
en: The vending machine’s hum recedes into the distance; light falls across the ground, slowly smoothing the shadows.

zh: （你的硬币数量不够）
en: (You don’t have enough coins.)

zh: ……看来想喝到水，得先在天台上凑够三枚硬币才行
en: …Looks like I’ll need to gather three coins on the rooftop if I want a drink.

zh: 总觉得……刚才好像错过了什么地方，再回去确认一下吧
en: I can’t shake the feeling I missed something—better go back and check.

zh: 看上去无人打理的长椅，椅脚以及周围的地面都长出了青苔
en: A bench that appears untended, with moss growing on its legs and on the surrounding ground

zh: 一扇紧闭的老旧铁门，门锁看上去十分牢固
en: A tightly shut old iron door; the lock looks very secure

zh: 一个繁茂的花圃，以鲜黄色花朵为主
en: A lush flowerbed dominated by bright yellow blossoms

zh: 一个边角有些磨坏但看起来十分结实的铁制公告栏，靠近有消毒水的气味
en: An iron notice board with worn corners but looking very sturdy; up close there’s a smell of disinfectant

zh: 上面的字迹被淡淡的青苔遮住，但依旧可以辨认：
en: The writing on it is veiled by a light moss, but still legible:

zh: 为保安全，请勿倚靠或攀爬防护栏
en: For safety, please do not lean on or climb the guardrail

zh: 一个保洁用的拖把，上面留有没有干透的水痕，旁边放着半瓶除草剂
en: A cleaning mop with still-damp streaks on it, and next to it a half-full bottle of herbicide

zh: 除草剂的瓶身冰凉，瓶口散发着一股格外刺鼻的化学药剂味
en: The herbicide’s bottle is cold to the touch, and the opening gives off an especially acrid chemical odor

zh: 从这湿拖把就能看出来，保洁阿姨早上指定是来打扫过了
en: From this wet mop you can tell the cleaning lady definitely came by to clean this morning

zh: 可这空气里，霉味跟一股刺鼻的药水味混在一块儿，也太难顶了
en: But the mustiness mixed with a sharp chemical reek in the air is really hard to bear.

zh: 阿姨这是下了猛料啊，杀毒效果先不说，杀伤力是够强的
en: She really went heavy on the stuff—never mind the disinfecting effect, the potency is plenty

zh: 随处可见的碎石头
en: Bits of gravel everywhere

zh: 碎石下有微光闪烁
en: A faint glimmer flickers beneath the gravel

zh: 你伸手拨开碎石，经过翻找，从泥土中拾起了一枚银色的硬币
en: You reach out to clear the gravel and, after searching, pick up a silver coin from the soil

zh: 你再次翻找了这些碎石，但没有任何新的发现
en: You search through the gravel again, but find nothing new

zh: 什么都没有发现
en: You find nothing

zh: 果然，天上不会掉两次馅饼
en: As expected, the sky doesn’t drop a windfall twice.

zh: 一片自然形成的草甸，各种不知名的草肆意生长在一起
en: A naturally formed meadow, with all kinds of unknown grasses growing unchecked together

zh: 空气里混杂着消毒水的化学气味、湿拖把散发的霉旧气息，以及泥土本身的味道
en: The air is a mix of the chemical smell of disinfectant, the musty staleness from the wet mop, and the scent of the earth itself

zh: 细看之下，不少植株都呈现不自然的萎蔫状态
en: On closer look, many plants show an unnatural wilted state

zh: 这是什么生态灾难现场吗
en: Is this some kind of ecological disaster scene?

zh: 说是草甸，结果土壤里全是化学药剂的味道和霉味
en: Call it a meadow, yet the soil reeks of chemicals and mildew

zh: 哇？这个告示牌……
en: Whoa—this notice board…

zh: 一股熟悉的潮湿霉味混着消毒水的味道，像是刚被人用湿抹布用力擦过
en: A familiar damp musty smell mixed with disinfectant, as if it had just been scrubbed hard with a wet cloth

zh: 上面青苔少得厉害，还留着些被硬生生蹭掉的痕迹……
en: The moss on it is greatly reduced, and there are still marks where it was forcibly rubbed off...

zh: 虽然可能是我多心了，但这种糟糕的感觉真让人不舒服
en: Although I might be overthinking it, this awful feeling is really uncomfortable

zh: 真希望这是我的错觉……
en: I really hope this is just my imagination...

zh: 既然上来了，还是把在意的地方都好好看看吧
en: Since I’m up here, I should carefully check all the places I’m concerned about

zh: 告示牌是检查完了……接下来该检查哪里来着？
en: The notice board is checked... what should I examine next again?

zh: 在游戏中，你需要通过完成<color=#FFC600>日记</color>中的事项来推进剧情
en: In the game, you need to advance the story by completing the items in the <color=#FFC600>Journal</color>

zh: 在日记界面中，你可以通过条目的<color=#FFC600>颜色</color>辨别任务状态：
en: In the journal interface, you can distinguish task status by the <color=#FFC600>color</color> of the entries:

zh: <color=#FFC600>灰色</color>代表未完成
en: <color=#FFC600>Gray</color> represents not completed

zh: <color=#FFC600>白色</color>代表已完成
en: <color=#FFC600>White</color> represents completed

zh: 当你清空当前日记中的所有<color=#FFC600>灰色</color>条目时，会触发关键剧情
en: When you clear all the <color=#FFC600>gray</color> entries in the current journal, a key plot will be triggered

zh: 现在请按下<color=#FFC600>ESC</color>键，打开系统的主菜单查阅日记
en: Now please press the <color=#FFC600>ESC</color> key to open the system main menu and check the journal

zh: 接下来，好好探索天台吧！
en: Next, go explore the rooftop properly!

zh: 需要留意的地方应该记在日记里面了
en: The places that need attention should be recorded in the journal

zh: 我记得日记里提到了几个关键点：左边的草甸、右边的盆栽，以及保洁工具和除草剂的组合
en: I remember the journal mentioned a few key points: the meadow on the left, the potted plants on the right, and the combination of cleaning tools and herbicide

zh: 重点看看这些地方吧，说不定就能搞清楚心中那种糟糕的感觉是什么了
en: Focus on these places; maybe I can figure out what that awful feeling inside is

zh: 终于凑齐三枚硬币了
en: Finally gathered three coins

zh: 现在去售货机那里看看吧
en: Now go take a look at the vending machine

zh: 应该可以买矿泉水了
en: I should be able to buy mineral water now

zh: 一扇虚掩着的老旧铁门，门轴上卡着一块显眼的扁石头
en: An old iron door stands ajar, with a conspicuous flat stone wedged in its hinge.

zh: 刚刚放的石头还卡在门轴上……现在最好别去动它
en: The stone I just placed is still wedged in the hinge… best not touch it now.

zh: 万一碰掉了石头，导致这扇门关上……我就真出不去了
en: If I knock the stone loose and the door swings shut… I really won’t be able to get out.
